headline: OpenAI launches always-on Dots agent at DevDay as Meta Muse rival
summary: OpenAI unveiled Dots, an always-on AI agent that works continuously in the background, at its DevDay conference as a response to Meta's fast-growing Muse platform. The launch came within a day of OpenAI shelving a planned model release over safety concerns, and followed Sam Altman's comment that OpenAI won't go public until its models are proven safe.
